topic: Smoke test for staging analytics environment
summary_markdown:
Someone requested a smoke test of the staging analytics environment (https://staging-analytics.allunite.com/). This version is configured with disabled assets and inventory for non-admin users.

The changes compared to production include contact management updates and internal query refactoring for the main and mobile dashboards. The request noted that while nothing should appear changed, it was important to test filters and modes as a precaution.
action_items: Run smoke test on staging analytics environment using non-admin credentials.
